# Else

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
If condition Then statement Else statement
Else
```

## Description

The part of an [If](If) that runs when the condition, and every [ElseIf](ElseIf) condition before it, is false. In the block form it stands on a line of its own.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For n = 1 To 3
	If n = 2
		Print "two"
	Else
		Print "not two"
	EndIf
Next
```

```text
not two
two
not two
```
